evals.name: query-by-category
evals.prompt: Add an endpoint GET /api/products/by-catalog-type/{catalogTypeId} to Products.API that returns the products of one catalog type.
evals.expected_output: A new query slice under Features/Products with a nested handler using ProductDbContext + AsNoTracking + Select to ProductDto, a route calling sender.SendAsync; the project builds.
expectations: Adds a new feature slice (query class with a nested handler) under Features/Products instead of a service or repository class
The handler reads with AsNoTracking and a Select projection to a DTO
The route sends the query through ISender.SendAsync and returns Results.Ok

evals.name: command-with-validator
evals.prompt: Add a command to Products.API that sets a product's available stock: PUT /api/products/{id}/stock with a quantity that must not be negative.
evals.expected_output: A new command slice with a FluentValidation validator rejecting negative quantities, a DataVerificationException for unknown products, and the PUT route; the project builds.
expectations: The new command has a FluentValidation validator that rejects a negative quantity
An unknown product id throws DataVerificationException instead of returning an error result
The handler uses ProductDbContext directly, with no repository or service layer

evals.name: integration-event-handler
evals.prompt: When a product is deleted in Products.API, publish a ProductDeletedIntegrationEvent carrying the product id through the event bus so other services can react.
evals.expected_output: A ProductDeletedIntegrationEvent derived from IntegrationEvent, published with IEventBus.PublishAsync from the DeleteProduct handler after the delete is saved; the project builds.
expectations: The event type derives from IntegrationEvent and carries the product id
The DeleteProduct handler publishes it through IEventBus.PublishAsync after SaveChangesAsync
